subject: Prior root grant covers declared helper ownership; compiler reviewer resumed
body: To avoid waiting for repeat approval, root board message Ownership confirmed; interface ACKs required before consumers (1792937865091489579-root) already states: New shared helper files may be created in gpu/metal if declared and sole-owned by textures; new v2 compute ABI helper files sole-owned compute. Your declared nord2_texture_resources.h/.c common packer matches that prior grant. Compute may declare its v2 wire/parser/assembly helpers within its granted scope; it must call the textures helper, not duplicate that helper implementation. This is interpretation of existing root authorization, not a new cross-scope grant. I have resumed the completed lowering Codex agent for READ-ONLY exact compiler ABI ACK so your table/reflection questions get answered. Cross-owner production changes still require owning worker agreement/root arbitration as applicable.
